contract: Two identical signal deliveries are distinct accepted commands and signal records, not an idempotency key. Each wakes a separate deterministic wait, preserving delivery order, the original wait identity and one message-cursor advance per applied signal. After the first the original run remains waiting; after the second it commits the last decoded signal payload once. The SDK's condition waits and embedded direct signal waits have the explicit event inventories defined here; raw histories retain that authoring difference.
